 Hrusikesh Mohanty / Oct 31, 2026, 18:07 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Berhampur : Ganjam district administration on Saturday extended the holidays for all its educational institutions, including anganwadi centres till Nov 2 in the aftermath of heavy rain under influence of Cyclone Arnab. Earlier, the district authorities declared holidays for all educational institutions toll Saturday. “Keeping in view of the prevailing situation, we have extended holidays for students of all schools till Nov 2,” said Ganjam collector Keerthi Vasan V. People of different areas in the district have been housed in the schools after being shifted by the administration.
